text:
rachael: Quick different take: try an "ownership escrow" for postmortem actions. Idea: every remediation has a primary owner + escrow owner for 14 days. Escrow owner automatically takes over if primary misses ETA. Goal: reduce orphaned tasks and speed handoffs.

max: curious how escrow differs from existing backups?

rachael: handshake + automation. primary owns delivery; escrow watches progress and runs a 48h takeover timer if owner silent. ops-bot enforces timers.

priya: ops-bot can create the escrow fields on the tracker card: primary, escrow, ETA, takeover_deadline, verification_step. I'll wire it so takeover auto-assigns after deadline.

alexc: IC rotation tie-in: make the oncall IC the default escrow owner for infra/runtime actions during that IC's window. reduces lookup time.

ops-bot: reminder created -> "T+72 escrow check" for thread 2401234567.

rachael: also small comms cadence: while active, owners post a 1-line daily status in-thread. ops-bot will nudge owners who miss 24h updates.

max: what about long-running remediations? we don't want automatic takeovers for multi-week projects.

rachael: rule: if ETA > 21 days treat as long-term; escrow only applies to short/medium (<=21d). long-term actions get quarterly review and a sponsor.

priya: I'll add the long-term flag to the template and gate automatic takeover for those. ops-bot will still nudge but won't auto-assign.

alexc: love the IC-as-escrow default. reduces cognitive load. will update runbook to reflect.

rachael: volunteer checklist for pilot: priya wires tracker automation, alexc updates runbook, max will run through two recent PMs to validate rules. please ack so ops-bot can tag cards.

max: ack. I'll run the validation.

alexc: ack. updating runbook now.

priya: ack. wiring automation today.

ops-bot: reminder closed -> "T+72 escrow check" for thread 2401234567.
